verdict.rationale: Reclaim's Scheduling Links can share 'you and your team's availability' and let others book across one or many calendars, and Smart Meetings find times across all attendees' schedules. However, nothing in the evidence explicitly describes a collective mode that shows only slots where every required host is free, as opposed to round-robin or any-host pooling. missing for 10: explicit documentation of collective or all-hosts-required booking logic, configuration of required vs optional hosts, independent or hands-on corroboration.
